follow-up time: Until delivery and 7 days postpartum for newborns
cohort: 44 pregnant women with asymptomatic bacteriuria confirmed by urine culture in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia.
finding: Asymptomatic bacteriuria during pregnancy was associated with a high frequency of adverse pregnancy outcomes, including preterm birth, low birth weight, asphyxiation at birth, and perinatal death.
